description: Perhaps a distant offshoot or an evolutionary relative of the sleek Nightling, the Frostling is a predator adapted to extremely low temperatures. The Frostling is a nocturnal animal that preys on the strange creatures inhabiting the frozen wastes.

label: frostmite
description: A large parasite usually found in cold places. attackSummary: left fist(12p/2s); right fist(12p/2s); teeth(8.2p/2s); head(5p/2s)

label: moribund gallatross
description:
Gallatross are deeply intelligent creatures, and they can somehow ascertain when they are close to death. They'll then instinctively direct themselves to an arid shrubland known as the Gallatross Graveyard, and die there alone, far from their group.

description: A large flightless bird, genetically modified to produce both edible eggs and a valuable silk-like textile. label: ocular jelly
description: The Rim is filled with creatures that might be the product of either accelerated evolution from terrestrial origins, or, more often, of ancient human genetic engineering gone awry. description: A floating chitinous creature covered in spikes and unblinking eyes. Created by infusing a very large animal with the strange energies from an extradimensional corruption.

attackSummary: left paw(11p/2.0s); right paw(11p/2.0s); AA_ToxicBite(6p/1.65s); head(3p/1.65s)
description: Wildpawns are a variant of the wildpods that have adapted to life outside of swamps and rainforests. Since they have less access to water and rotting vegetation, they grow much less, and are much less dangerous. Wildpawns are less resistant to gunfire, but retain the weakness to fire of their bigger brethren. Wildpawns reproduce asexually by releasing clumps of spores every few weeks, so its child

label: wildpod
attackSummary: left paw(23p/2.0s); right paw(23p/2.0s); AA_ToxicBite(15p/1.65s); head(6p/1.65s)
description: This lumbering mass of apparently decomposing plant matter is a Wildpod, a sentient mycoid creature native to some jungle infested planet on the Rim. The Wildpod is almost impervious to gunfire, with bullets simply being absorbed into its mass without doing much damage, but very weak to fire. Interestingly, it reproduces asexually by releasing clumps of spores every few weeks, so its children are

label: windbeast
description: The windbeast is a mechanoid-infused variant of the thunderbeast, in which the bioelectric organs have been removed and replaced with fleshy tentacles housing a distributed net of weather-affecting mechanites.\n\nThese deployable mechanite swarms have the ability to affect the weather in a localized manner, creating pressure gradients that may evolve into full-blown hurricane winds. This effect is

label: black empress
description: An incredibly rare and monstrously large insectoid of the Black Hive geneline. Unlike its Sorne counterpart, the black empress is not worried about creating offspring, feeling more concerned about acting as an absolute nightmare in close quarters combat. She can tear through heavy armour as if it wasn't there, but what makes her particularly dangerous is her ability to absolutely melt any mechanoi

label: black insectoid queen
description: A giant, genetically-engineered insectoid responsible for creating new Black Hive spawn. A mother to the insects in her hive, a black queen doesn’t do heavy work, and tries to avoid combat if possible. As massive as an adult thrumbo, the queen instils fear in most opponents. Her thick chitinous armour makes her hard to kill, whilst long, deadly blades can tear through plasteel shielding in seconds

label: black swarmlings
description: The juvenile form of Black Hive insectoids, black swarmlings are more or less harmless, slow and easy to kill. After some time has passed, they undergo a metamorphosis, forming a cocoon from which an adult Black Hive insectoid will emerge. There is no way to tell what kind of insect will crawl out of its cocoon.

label: apoptosis
description: Malice incarnate, the Apoptosis is an advanced Apocriton that acts as a commander designed to coordinate and motivate other mechs during long extermination campaigns. They are less adept at resurrecting other mechanoids than Apocritons, but the aura of hate they emanate is so powerful and intense that it will cause uncontrollable despair on those too close to it.\n\nThe Apoptosis is armed with two

label: aura
description: The Aura, also known as Avenging Angels, are angel-shaped mechanoids surrounded by a whirling cloud of six levitating metallic blades. They favour close combat, approaching their victims and engulfing them in an eviscerating whirlwind of slashing death. They also have the ability to regenerate their wounds with fast acting mechanites.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Auras don't have muc

label: blitzkrieg
description: The Blietzkrieg is a unique mechanoid designed for tactical warfare and area denial. Shaped like a sleek and menacing metallic mine, it is capable of self-propelling itself to the intended target location before detonating in a devastating explosion. However, its indiscriminate detonation makes it a double-edged sword, and careful coordination is required to ensure that it does not harm friendly f

label: daggersnout
description: The daggersnout is a fast, insectlike combat mechanoid armed with a vicious sharp blade on its head. It isn't as dangerous as other close-ranged mechanoids, such as scythers, but they usually appear in greater numbers.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> If toggled to not spawn via mod options, they will get replaced by a Scyther.

label: demolisher
description: The strange demolisher mechanoid looks like a weird amalgamation of a deep sea crab, a star-nosed mole and an armoured combat vehicle. Demolishers are armed with a very dangerous short range turret that fires demolisher charges, capable of blowing up even the strongest walls in two or three hits. Once they have ruptured a colony's outer defenses, their enormous plasteel reinforced claws can make s

label: fireworm
description:
A huge mechanical worm armed with a dangerous chemfuel flamethrower. Their weapon has a very short range, so don't let a fireworm approach your defenses!

The fireworm superficially resembles a Frostbound Behemoth. A coincidence? Or perhaps mechanoids take living things as a blueprint for their units. If so, you wouldn't want to see what a biological scyther looks like...

label: goliath
description: The Goliath is a heavy combat mechanoid with a humanoid body plan. They are faster than centipedes, and are usually armed with heavy mechanoid weapons or needle guns.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Faster than a centipede, but weaker due to their weaker weapons. If built by the player, it will have a "Swap weapon" ability to choose between the charge blaster and the Needle gun. If togg

label: infernus
description: An ultra-heavy mechanoid with an incredibly dangerous orbital strike targeter. The targeter won't cause any damage on its own, but a devastating orbital strike will be launched a few seconds after it finishes focusing on a target. This attack takes a long time to charge, and it has a large minimum range. The Infernus accumulates heat constantly due to its enormous size, and it can release it to ig

label: artilleron
description: A variation of the militor and bellicor, the artilleron stands at a height of around 5 feet and it is armed with a powerful mortar that fires explosive canisters with great accuracy. With its reduced durability, the Artilleron can't withstand intense battles and is often deployed in the rear lines to eliminate high priority targets and secure strategic objectives from afar. It can also swap weapon

label: bellicor
description: An advanced combat mechanoid designed to excel in high-risk combat situations. With a height of around 5 feet, it is armed with a rapid-firing tactical mechanoid shotgun. Unlike its predecessor, the Militor, the Bellicor is highly durable and has the ability to withstand intense battles. It is often deployed in the front lines to eliminate high priority targets and secure strategic objectives. Due

label: guttersnipe
description: A small, deployable combat mechanoid usually manufactured inside an ultra-heavy war empress mech. Contrary to War urchins, the Guttersnipe is a melee fighter, using its wicked circular saws to lunge at their targets. They have a non-rechargeable power source.

label: legate
description: An ultraheavy mech with a built-in advanced shield bubble generator. The Legate lacks the point-defense bulb turret present in Centurions, but in exchange it is armed with a super heavy charge blaster that is much more dangerous than standard ones.

label: lux
description: The Lux is a sleek and agile humanoid mechanoid designed for fast-paced combat operations. Equipped with a powerful heavy laser weapon, it is capable of dealing devastating damage to both ground and air targets with pinpoint accuracy. The Lux's agility comes at the cost of durability, and it must rely on its speed and evasion to survive on the battlefield.

label: culinarius
description: Designed for culinary arts, the Culinarius can analyze ingredients and create delicious meals with exceptional precision and consistency. The Culinarius can access an extensive database of recipes, culinary techniques, and flavor profiles, allowing it to adapt and customize its cooking style to suit any cuisine or dietary requirement. Its sturdy metal frame and robust construction make it resistan

label: munifex
description: The Munifex are formidable human-sized combat mechanoids designed specifically for long-range combat scenarios. They are equipped with advanced coil lances, which are mass driver weapons that fire electromagnetically accelerated slugs at incredible velocities. These projectiles are capable of penetrating through almost any kind of defense, including thick armor plating and reinforced concrete.\n\n

label: optio
description: An elite combat support mechanoid that employs a rotary needle launcher. Its armor is reinforced to withstand heavy firepower, and it can project a formidable energy shield to protect nearby allies. The Optio is a valuable asset on the battlefield, able to quickly adapt to changing situations and provide crucial support to other mechanoids.

label: polychoron
description: A heavy combat mechanoid with a graser cannon that can deal massive damage to armored targets. Though it lacks agility, its graser cannon is capable of firing focused energy beams that can cut through most shielding and leave enemies defenseless.

label: pristine assembler
description: An automated, mobile mechanoid factory. The assembler is designed for efficient energy-to-matter conversion. Using its advanced molecular assembly system, it can convert various forms of energy into usable materials with remarkable precision. This particular assembler doesn't need to consume organic matter to aid in the conversion, being compatible with standard mech rechargers.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>

label: pristine slurrypede
description: Although rare, mechanoids have been known to capture prisoners, and the Slurrypede is their solution to feed them in the most efficient way possible. The Slurrypede is a modified bio-mechanoid capable of extracting energy from standard mech rechargers and use it to process inorganic matter into a homogeneous organic slurry. This slurry is edible for carnivore and omnivore animals, but barely, and

label: sagittarius
description: The Sagittarius is a humanoid mechanoid equipped with a powerful tesla gun, a fearsome energy weapon designed to unleash a cascade of electromagnetic energy upon its targets. Capable of generating a burst of EMP energy that can stun and disable mechanoids with a single shot. At the same time, it unleashes a searing bolt of electrical energy that can burn through organic targets, leaving them smold

label: turbocleaner
description: Basically a cleansweeper mounted on two small gyro-stabilized turbine engines. The turbocleaner hovers over terrain, using a vacuum nozzle to suction dirt and other debris. Absurdly useless in combat.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Hovers over terrain, ignoring terrain movement costs.

label: phalanx
description:
A hulking mechanoid based on a rhinoceros beetle body plan. The phalanx's plasteel carapace hides a very powerful cryogenic engine capable of constantly producing compacted pellets of supercooled gas. These are fired from an aperture at the mechanoid's head.

This cryo-weapon has a very low range, but it can be very dangerous for beings susceptible to frostbite.

label: pristine strider
description: A more advanced, mechanite-grown version of the autostrider, the pristine strider has a large carrying capacity, making it perfect as a partner on long caravan trips. Can also be ridden by pawns to increase travel speed.

label: siegebreaker
description: The siegebreaker is a particularly dangerous tank-shaped mechanoid. Armed with a Siegebreaker Cannon that fires explosive shells, they can detect a hostile presence from hundreds of meters away, acting as unrelenting siege weapons that can obliterate even the strongest defense. Their movement is incredibly slow, and their cannon takes a very long time to recharge, but they should be treated as pri

label: siegemelter
description: The siegemelter is a variant of the siegebreaker armed with a powerful flamethrower. Their movement is incredibly slow, but their siegemelter turret has a considerable range, so they should be treated as priority targets in most cases.

label: starfire
description: The Starfire mechanoid is a massive tank-like machine, equipped with a powerful cannon that fires very slow-moving unstable singularities. These singularities are generated by a complex fusion reactor at the heart of the machine, which channels and amplifies energy from nearby stars via microscopic skipgates. When fired, the singularities unleash devastating amounts of energy, capable of obliterat

label: war empress

description: An ultra-heavy mech with a built-in mech gestator. Fed with appropriate resources, the War empress can form swarms of small melee-adept guttersnipe combat mechs within its massive carapace and deploy them into combat. label: corruptor dryad
attackSummary: left claw(8p/2s); right claw(8p/2s); Bite(9p/2s); head(4p/2s)

label: ocular dryad
attackSummary: left claw(8p/2s); right claw(8p/2s); Bite(9p/2s); head(4p/2s)
description: A corrupted dryad afflicted by a bizarre extradimensional disease that causes gaping wounds to appear all over its body, from which ocular orbs slowly emerge. label: spitter dryad
attackSummary: left claw(8p/2s); right claw(8p/2s); Bite(9p/2s); head(4p/2s)
description: A dryad caste specialized in venomous ranged attacks. They reproduce together with their tree, which contains a hidden dryad queen. Dryads can morph into various specialized castes.

label: tumorous dryad
attackSummary: left claw(8p/2s); right claw(8p/2s); Bite(9p/2s); head(4p/2s)
description: A corrupted dryad covered in tumorous growths that constantly appear over its whole body.
