description: Loth-cats were a non-sentient feline species from the planet Lothal. They were small, temperamental creatures, and while at times friendly, were still able hunters with sharp teeth and claws. They were often kept as pets.

label: lylek
attackSummary: left tentacle(28p/2.0s); right tentacle(28p/2.0s); poison stinger(24p/2.6s); teeth(24p/1.4s); head(16p/2.4s)
description: The lylek was the most dangerous predator indigenous to the planet of Ryloth. It's strange biology made it one of the few creatures able to survive in the harsh heat of the Bright Lands. These dangerous creatures were popular exotic pets with certain criminal organisations and subsequently were transported to various worlds.

label: maalraas
attackSummary: left paw(12p/2s); right paw(12p/2s); Bite(18p/2s); head(8p/2s)
description: Maalraas (or 'Nighthunters') were a non-sentient species of predatory quadrupeds of unknown planetary origin. Maalraas hunted in packs, primarily preying upon cannoks and other small creatures. It is believed they used "the force" to assist in camouflaging themselves from both predator and prey. For a time they had heightened popularity with several crime syndicates as attack beasts which resulted

label: manka
attackSummary: tusks(24p/2s); left claw(12p/1.5s); right claw(12p/1.5s); razor-fangs(14p/2s); head(8p/2s)
description: Manka (or 'manka cats') were a large predatory feline species native to the planets Tython and Alderaan. Fur-covered quad-tusked quadrupeds, 'manka cats' were considered dangerous by most sentients who encountered them and were often hunted for safety reasons as well as for resources (their tusks were known to have unusual curative properties). Manka cat populations were present on numerous worlds

label: marsh haunt
attackSummary: left fist(18p/1.5s); right fist(18p/1.5s); Bite(10p/2s); head(16p/2s)
description: A marsh haunt was a 'Force-using' red-eyed creature that was native to the planet Abraxim, but they could be found on many worlds in the Mid and Outer Rim. The marsh haunt had dull, peeling, gray-green skin, camouflaging it in the swampy terrains in which it primarily lived. Its bipedal stance and skull set deeply between its shoulders gave its silhouette the appearance of a humanoid lacking a hea

label: massiff
attackSummary: left claw(9.9p/2s); right claw(9.9p/2s); Bite(16p/2s); head(6p/2s)
description: Massiffs were reptilian creatures found on both Geonosis and Tatooine, although it's planet of origin is unknown. Massiffs were reptiles that had coarse skin, large jaws, toothy mouths, big dark eyes and a line of hard spikes along their backs. Canine in appearance with an armored hide, the beasts could be domesticated and used for sentry and guard tasks and were often exported to other worlds for

label: mastiff phalone
attackSummary: beak(18p/2s); left claw(8p/1.5s); right claw(8p/1.5s); head(6p/2s)
description: Mastiff phalone were carnivorous flightless avians native to the savannas of Maridun. The mastiff phalones had turkey-like heads with a sharp beak and a mane of large brown feathers which males of the species used in courtship displays. Mastiff phalones descended from flying creatures, with their wings evolved back into powerful limbs and tended to hunt in packs of two to four. They were popular b

label: mastmot
attackSummary: tusk(28p/2s); horn(19p/2s); left foot(15p/2s); right foot(15p/2s)
description: Mastmots (sometimes called 'motmots') were massive, thick-furred, quadrupedal ungulates. Being herd-dwelling herbivores, they lived on the harsh, frigid world of Toola. The indigenous Whiphid people hunted the mastmots, using the body parts for food, clothing, shelter, and tools. It is from this that the animal would often find itself exported to other worlds where Whipids would or did inhabit. Ho

label: mawvorr
attackSummary: left claw(8p/2s); right claw(8p/2s); Bite(16p/2s); head(6p/2s)
description: Mawvorr (also known as'crysfangs'), were a vibrant mammalian species native to the planet Voss. These brightly coloured chitinous creatures were predatory in nature but could be the right skill forms bonds with skilled handlers. They became popular in the exotic pet trade due to their striking appearance, which ultimately resulted in their spread to other worlds.

label: mott
attackSummary: left claw(4p/2s); right claw(4p/2s); Bite(9p/2s); head(6p/2s)
description: Motts were medium sized, semi-aquatic herbivores native to the swamps of Naboo. They ate a wide variety of vegetation and were a primary source of food for most swamp predators. Fortunately, motts had a high reproduction rate.

label: mudhorn
description: Mudhorns were large horned creatures that originated from the planet Arvala-7. The eggs of mudhorns were considered a delicacy by Jawas. It was this reason that populations of these creatures were established on other worlds as a result of unscrupulous bartering deals.

label: mynock
description: Mynocks were silicon-based parasitical organisms found across the galaxy. They were considered parasites by pilots and starport personnel. Their strange metabolism allowed them to digest various metals and components for nutritional value.

label: narglatch
attackSummary: left claw(18p/1.5s); right claw(18p/1.5s); Bite(26p/2s); head(12p/2s)
description: The Narglatch was a stealthy apex predator which could be found in diverse environments, such as the swamps of Naboo or the frozen tundras of Orto Plutonia. The narglatch male had additional fleshy spikes, while females were smoother and slightly smaller. They both had non-retractable claws and a fan-like tail that acted as a rudder during high-speed chases and turns. The narglatch also had densel

label: neebray
description: Neebray were flying, limbless creatures which varied greatly in size and habitat. They could be found on many worlds, such as Rugosa, Rishi moon, and Tatooine. There are several species of neebray, varying in size and appearance but all were tolerant to the vacuum of space.

label: nerf
attackSummary: horns(8p/1.65s); Bite(8.8p/2.6s); left hoof(8p/2s); right hoof(8p/2s); head(7p/2s)
description: Nerfs were a species of furry, non-sentient animals raised for their milk, meat, and hide. They could be found on a variety of planets across the galaxy, from Alderaan to Lothal. Despite their usefulness, nerfs were often regarded as disgusting because of their strong body odor.

label: nexu
attackSummary: left claw(11p/1.5s); right claw(11p/1.5s); teeth(15p/2s); tail(5p/2s)
description: Nexu's are agile predators with four red eyes and sharp quills. They have infrared vision and are 4.51 meters long. Typically 0.94 meters tall, nexus possess sharp teeth and claws, as well as long tails. It's light build allows it to remain highly agile and difficult to hit.

label: nuna
description: Nuna (commonly called 'swamp turkeys'), were reptavian gamebirds native to the planet Naboo. Nuna were diminutive bipeds, mostly covered in scaly skin and sporting a distinctive dorsal ridge. They possessed a notably prominent jutting jaw and two large wattles hanging from either side of their mouths. They were transported as livestock as well as a game animal, allowing for wild populations on oth

label: ollopom
description: Ollopoms were squat, gentle herbivores native to the swamps of the planet Naboo. A species of six-legged aquatic rodent, they were often mistaken for water plants. These short, gentle, dense, green-furred rodents were camouflaged to blend in with the Pom Petals whose edges they fed upon. On their underside, they had gnawing teeth and three pairs of paddle-like claws. Their flukes were used as rudd

label: orray
attackSummary: left claw(14p/1.5s); right claw(14p/1.5s); Bite(28p/2s); head(12p/2s)
description: Orrays were leathery-skinned reptilian quadrupeds native to the planet Geonosis. The orray had great strength and a quick gait; making it a popular pack animal when domesticated (especially on arid worlds). The orrays used their long snouts to root for insects in time of food scarcity.

label: painted spat
description: The painted spat was an avian predator believed to have originated on the planet Talus. A mutated variant (possibly from toxic exposure), this creature was larger, stronger and more resistant than other spat subspecies.

label: Peko-peko
attackSummary: left wing claws(6p/1.5s); wing claws(6p/1.5s); strong beak(16p/2s); head(12p/2s)
description: Peko-pekos were large colourful reptavians whose raucous squawks that carried over long distances. They were native to the Gungan swamps of the planet Naboo, but another breed was known to live on Nal Hutta. Their vibrant colours and vocal emulation made them popular as pets and they were exported to multiple worlds. Their skin contained a mild toxin which meant most predators ignored them (allowi

label: pikobis
description: Pikobi were fast-moving, flightless reptavians which were native to the swamps of Naboo and the jungles of Onderon. Pikobis also had long, pointed beaks lined with sharp teeth that were used to spear and hold onto slippery prey which it usually swallowed in one gulp. Due to their small size they were often able to hide as stowaways aboard large cargo ships, surviving by scavenging and escaping to

label: porg
description: The Porg.

label: Pufferpig
description: Pufferpigs were a non-sentient, herbivorous porcine species native to the planet Kyryll. Puffer pigs were occasionally bred for their meat, which was consumable by several sentient species and resulted in the animal being exported to numerous planets. The true value of a Puffer pig was it's ability to sniff out certain precious metals.

label: qormot
attackSummary: left claw(8p/2s); right claw(8p/2s); quills(9.0p/2s); Bite(10.0p/2s); head(6p/2s)
description: Qormots were omnivorous forest creatures from the planet Yeshocq. During the mating season their ferocity increased, usually making anyone bold (or foolish) enough to stray into Qormot territory a likely target. However, much to the dismay of the game hunters who exported these creatures to various worlds, their seasonal aggression diminished heavily when transplanted.

label: Rancor
attackSummary: left hand(20p/2s); right hand(20p/2s); teeth(30p/2s); left foot(12p/2s); right foot(12p/2s); head(15p/2s)
description: Rancors were large carnivorous reptomammals native to the planet of Dathomir. Standing around five meters tall, with their long arms, immense jaws, and armored hides that could withstand blaster fire, they are formidable predators. A subspecies known as the jungle rancor populates the planets Felucia and Teth.

label: raxshir
attackSummary: left claw(14p/1.5s); right claw(14p/1.5s); Bite(16p/2s); head(8p/2s)
description: Raxshir (also referred to as 'sabertooths') were a large predatory felines with bony cranial crests that were native to the pine forests of the planet Shili. It's striped fur help camouflage it when stalking prey and it was a natural predator to the agile kybuck. Their significance within Togrutan culture has resulted in the export of this creature to many of the worlds in which they themselves ha

label: reek
attackSummary: horn(19p/2s); horn(19p/2s); horn(19p/2s); Bite(19p/2.6s); head(15p/2s); front left hoof(10p/2s); front right hoof(10p/2s)
description: Reeks are large, muscular quadrupeds native to the planet Ylesia. Their sprawling posture and immense weight make them relatively slow-moving. They sport two large cheek horns that can be used for head-locking in combat with another Reek as a show of dominance.

label: rikknit
attackSummary: left claw(8p/2s); right claw(8p/2s); tail(6p/2s); Bite(4p/2s); head(4p/2s)
description: The rikknit were an arboreal crustacean native to the planet New Plympto. Female rikknit had ovum sacs connected to their abdomens, which when removed via butchery were considered a delicacy. Harvested ovum sacs could also be processed into an addictive substance called ji rikknit. It is likely these creatures are escaped livestock that have since gone on to establish wild populations.

label: roggwart
attackSummary: left arm claws(18p/2s); right arm claws(18p/2s); teeth(26p/2s); trident-tipped tail(18p/2s); cranial horns(12p/2s)
description: Roggwarts were large, predatory beasts with sizeable populations on the planets Mustafar, Vendaxa, and Guiteica. These creatures were incredibly heat resistant and had an aggressive nature. Typically, only those taken from the most young of age are able to be trained as pets or guardians. Roggwarts were a favorite pet of the Kaleesh warriors and thus populations were able to establish themselves o

label: ronto
attackSummary: Bite(17p/2.6s); left foot(19p/2s); right foot(19p/2s); head(28p/2s)
description: Ronto were large, quadruped mammals that were commonly used as beasts of burden on Tatooine. They were known for their loyalty and strength, being able to carry heavy cargo. Their tolerance to heat and relatively low food consuption made them a popular export to arid worlds as beasts of burden.

label: runyip
attackSummary: left hoof(8p/2s); right hoof(8p/2s); horn(8p/2s); head(16p/2.9s)
description: Runyip or Yavin Runyip were a species of squat quadrupeds from the moon Yavin 4. The creatures had antlered heads with a flexible nose. Their coats had a characteristic pattern of black or dark brown stripes on a whitish background. It is believed this striation made them a popular game animal for export to other worlds.

label: rycrit
attackSummary: Bite(16.0p/2s); left claws(6p/2s); right claws(6p/2s); head(10p/2s)
description: Rycrits were hardy herd animals native to Ryloth. Twi'leks raised them for their hides, and as a source of meat (which is universally considered to be delicious). Their sharp teeth and hooves as well as their multiple nostrils were adaptations for dealing with Ryloths extreme weather and vicious predators. The cultural, culinary and practical significance of the Rycrit meant they could be found on

label: Scavrats
attackSummary: left claw(5.5p/2s); right claw(5.5p/2s); Bite(8p/2s); head(4p/2s)
description: Scavrats were large, omnivorous rodents of unknown planetary origin albeit common enough on multiple worlds that they were considered pests. They were often mistaken for the Tattooinian Womp Rat, but the big behavioural distinction here being that they were not predatory and far more sociable creatures despite their strange appearance.

label: scurrier
attackSummary: left claw(3p/2s); right claw(3p/2s); Bite(4p/2s); head(2p/2s)
description: The scurrier was a rodent native to the planet Tatooine. They were fast breeding, curious omnivores that many considered a pest. The males could be distinguished from females by their curved display horns. They were known to find their way aboard docked freighters and transports, thus propagating the scurrier population across the galaxy.

label: shaak
attackSummary: head(12p/2.9s); left hoof(6p/2s); right hoof(6p/2s); Bite(4p/2s)
description: Shaaks were plump pachydermoid herd animals native to the planet of Naboo. Shaaks were often raised for their meat, and had large, rotund bodies. Due to their high rate of reproduction they were often sold offworld in livestock markets.

label: shiro
description: Shiros were hard-shelled, benign, slow-moving reptiles native to the planet of Naboo. A Shiro's main defense was to retract its head, legs and tail into its spiny shell. The Shiro's low metabolism meant it could be transported over long journeys and understandably the species was spread to many worlds.

label: shiro-trap
description: The Shiro-trap was native to planet Naboo and was not entirely a separate creature, but in fact a symbiotic pairing of a Tooke-trap plant and a Shiro. The plant disguised the animal, while the Shiro provided the plant a form of locomotion. The plant influences the animal host in one other interesting way by making the generally herbivorous Shiro into a more active predator to repel would be herbiv

label: shyrack
attackSummary: left scythe claw(6p/2s); right scythe claw(6p/2s); Bite(9p/2s); tail(8p/2s)
description: Shyracks were large, bat-like avian creatures with razor like teeth native to the caves of the planet Korriban. While ungainly and slow-moving without eyes, Shyracks were potentially dangerous pests, especially when they converged as a flock on an opponent. It's believed these creatures were spread to various planets as "live prey" for the others beasts in Sith armies (such as the Tuk'ata).

label: silooth
attackSummary: mandibles(25p/2s); Bite(18p/2s); head horn(14p/2s); front left claw(10p/2s); front right claw(10p/2s)
description: The silooth were a large 'Sithspawn' acid spitting beetle bred by the Sith Empire for use as a warbeast. Silooth were ferocious creatures using their powerful mandibles to crush their prey or tear down trees and buildings. They were spread to numerous worlds either intentionally or accidentally by the Sith. These descendents whilst not as large and ferocious (another process of feral regression in

label: skalder
attackSummary: tusk(25p/2.6s); left foot(16.9p/2s); right foot(16.9p/2s); head(14p/2s)
description: The skalder were a mammalian desert species of herbivorous quadrupeds native to the plains of the planet Florrum. They were not normally ridden by sentient beings, but were surprisingly fast if such a feat was managed. They made exceptional pack animals, even in toxic environments and so were exported by pirate bands for use offworld.

label: sketto
attackSummary: left clawed paw(8p/1.5s); right clawed paw(8p/1.5s); beak(12p/2s); head(6p/1.5s)
description: Skettos were carnivorous flying reptiles that dwelled in the caverns of the planet Tatooine. Only emerging at daybreak and twilight, they possessed many rods in their eyes to assist their vision in low-light conditions as they ate airborne insects. Though reptilian, they were warm-blooded and gave birth to a single offspring at a time. Their small size and lower metabolism made them excellent stow

label: snoruuk
description: Snoruuks were mobile mushrooms found on the planet Gamorr. They could be herded and were the favourite livestock of the Gamorreans, which resulted in their transplantation to other worlds.

label: squall
attackSummary: Bite(4.0p/2s); left claws(3p/2s); right claws(3p/2s); head(2p/2s)
description: Squalls were small lagomorphs originally from the planet Chandrila. Squall instinctively seemed to want to be around other non-predatory creatures of any species, including sentient species. When in the company of other creatures, they typically begged for food or raided unguarded food stores. In the Core Worlds, squalls were renowned for their cuteness, and even further out, most beings found it

label: stintaril
attackSummary: left claw(8p/2s); right claw(8p/2s); Bite(12p/2s); head(6p/2s)
description: The stintarils were a species of rapacious arboreal rodents native to the moon Yavin 4. They were predators and their prey mainly consisted of woolamanders and whisper birds, but could and would hunt other small to medium sized creatures. The metabolism of the stintaril was extremely high, and they had to eat often. It's very likely these voracious predators were introduced and established themsel

label: strill
attackSummary: left claw(10.9p/2s); right claw(10.9p/2s); Bite(18p/2s); head(6p/2s)
description: Strills were a species of highly intelligent, six-legged carnivorous mammals native to the planet Mandalore. They had folds of leathery skin between their legs which allowed them to glide short distances with sufficient updraft and they purportedly had a very distinct (often unpleasant) smell. A number of Mandalorians took to keeping strills (or 'striile' in Mando'a) as pets, making use of their n

label: tach
attackSummary: left fist(6p/1.5s); right fist(6p/1.5s); Bite(8p/2s); head(4p/2s)
description: The tach were a species tree-dwelling primates native to the planet Kashyyyk. A friendly creature, the tach could often be found on the ground searching for overripe fruits. They were exported to various worlds by unscrupulous business enterprises harvest their brain glands for use in the production of expensive Tarisian ale.

label: taozin
attackSummary: spiked-tail(24p/2.2s); left claws(20p/2.0s); right claws(20p/2.0s); insectoid maw(12p/1.4s); head(16p/2.4s)
description: The Taozin (also known as a 'force dragon') was a giant predatory annelid with many arms and legs native to the jungle moon of Va'art. Finding their way all over the galaxy, Taozin were thought to be extinct but this may in fact be due to their highly elusive nature. They produce an rare curiosity from their skin when butchered known as a 'Taozin nodule'.

label: tauntaun
attackSummary: left claws(7p/1.2s); right claws(7p/1.2s); teeth(8p/1.4s); head(13p/2.6s)
description: Tauntauns are a species of omnivorous reptomammals who are indigenous to the icy planet of Hoth. Tauntauns were commonly used as pack animals during the Rebel Alliance's stay at Hoth. Tauntauns were also used as patrol mounts when it was learned that the Rebel Alliance's own vehicles could not cope with the very cold weather.

label: tee muss
attackSummary: head(12p/2.9s); left hoof(6p/2s); right hoof(6p/2s); Bite(12p/2s)
description: Tee-muss were a species of domesticated farm animals native to the jungle planet Onderon. They were found on various worlds around the galaxy due to escape from domestic populations.

label: tet'niss crab
description: Tet'niss crabs were a species of large trash crab that lived on the planet Lanupa. Specialised glands on their shell would secrete a sticky substance which allowed the creature to attach pieces of scrap metal to their body for additional defense from predation. Sometimes this resulted in the creatures being mistaken for scrap and transported to other worlds for processing only for them wander off

label: thranta
description: Thrantas were a group of flying animals originally found on the planet Alderaan. While there were multiple species and breeds varying in size and functions, most thrantas served as air transport. Populations of wild thranta were established on numerous worlds (like Bespin) where the air pollution was low.

label: tibidee
attackSummary: left claws(20p/2.0s); right claws(20p/2.0s); Bite(16p/2s); head(28p/2s); tail(32p/2.2s)
description: Tibidees were giant silicon-based creature native to Stygeon Prime, though they could also be found on other mountainous Outer Rim planets (such as Oosalon). Though normally gentle, tibidees would attack anything they felt was threatening.

label: tooke
attackSummary: left claw(4p/2s); right claw(4p/2s); Bite(5p/2s); head(2p/2s)
description: Tooke were small, hopping rodents native to the planet Naboo. They were nocturnal by nature and like all rodents, the tooke had a high reproductive rate and they generally fed on nuts and berries. They were a common pest animal that spread readily to many worlds including Stoga, where predators like the worrt would gorge themselves immobile consuming them. label: torton
attackSummary: Bite(28p/2.6s); horn(24p/2s); left foot(19p/2s); right foot(19p/2s); head(17p/2s)
description: Tortons were huge predatory estudines that were believed to have originated on Naboo's moon of Rori, but identical such specimens existed on other worlds such as the Tortur from the planet Talus. Their tough shells made them formidable foes in angered, however their bulk made them slow and cumbersome.

label: tuk'ata
attackSummary: left claw(18p/1.5s); right claw(18p/1.5s); poisonous fangs(26p/2s); tail stinger(12p/2s); head(8p/2s)
description: The tuk'ata (or 'Sith hounds'), were used for thousands of years to guard the tombs of the Dark Lords of the Sith on the planet Korriban. Tuk'ata were unusually intelligent and were even rumoured to communicate with one another through means unknown. It was claimed that originally the species were non-violent grazing animals before being corrupted by Sith alchemy experiments that awakened latent p

label: tusk cat
attackSummary: left claw(14p/1.5s); right claw(14p/1.5s); Bite(16p/2s); head(10p/2s)
description: The tusk cat were large feline predators from the worlds of Naboo and its moon Rori. Tusk cats had a large pair of distinct tusks growing from their lower jaws. This put them at morphological odds with many tusked animals which often featured tusks growing from the upper jaw. label: urusai
description: Urusai were winged reptavians native to the desert planet Tatooine. They were predominantly opportunistic scavengers of carrion that would use the thermal currents of their homeworld to travel far and wide in search of an easy meal. Their tolerance to harsh climates and propensity to be clean, efficive corpse disposal meant they were spread to numerous worlds by various corporate and criminal orga

label: uvak
description: Uvak were a large, membranous-winged reptavian species with sharp beaks. They were native to the planet of Kesh, where they were used by the indigenous Keshiri as pack animals and mounts. It's was believed that the deities known as the "Skyborn" may have transplanted these creatures to other worlds before disappearing into Keshiri mythology.

label: vapaad
attackSummary: left toxic tentacle(12p/1s); right toxic tentacle(12p/1s); left toxic tentacle(14p/1.5s); right toxic tentacle(14p/1.5s)
description: The vapaad, was a large predatory creature native to the world of Sarapin and its moons. Vaapads were brown ball-shaped, tripod creatures with two yellow eyes and multiple tentacles used to kill prey. A vaapad attacked by striking its prey with its toxic tentacles so quickly that they were nothing but a blur to the naked eye. They were exported offworld for use in exotic gladiatorial arenas.

label: varactyl
description: Varactyls, also known as 'dragonmounts', were reptavian herbivores native to the planet Utapau, though some specimens found their way to other worlds (such as Kashyyyk and Belsavis) as their eggs were easily transported by Black-marketeers. They had beaked faces and long, powerful tails and not only could a varactyl run very fast, but their feet were adapted with tiny hairlike structures that allo

label: veermok
attackSummary: left fist(18p/1.5s); right fist(18p/1.5s); Bite(18p/2s); head(8p/2s)
description: Veermoks were a ferocious species of clawed and fanged primates native to the planet Naboo (but with sizeable populations on both Eriadau and Xirl). Living in swamps and moist woodlands, veermoks were arboreal creatures. They were also solitary and aggressive creatures, spending the majority of their lives without others of their kind. Their popularity amongst big game hunters meant they were expo

label: voorpak
attackSummary: left claw(4p/1.5s); right claw(4p/1.5s); Bite(6p/2s); head(2p/2s)
description: Voorpaks were a non-sentient but still quite smart species of puffy-looking mammalians that were native to the planet of Naboo. Diminutive carnivores, voorpaks were much beloved by many due to their cuteness and as pets which in turn led to their export to many other worlds.

label: vornskyr
attackSummary: whip-like tail(8p/2s); left paw(13p/2s); right paw(13p/2s); Bite(20p/2s); head(8p/2s)
description: The vornskr were a pack hunting canine beast native to the forest planet Myrkr. Vornskrs were primarily nocturnal hunters, and used their whip-like, mildly venomous tails to stun prey before finishing it off with their teeth. They were popular attack beasts and pets within several criminal organisations and thus they were spread to numerous worlds as a result.

label: vulptex
attackSummary: left claw(3.6p/2s); right claw(3.6p/2s); cute little teeth(4.8p/2s); head(2p/2s)
description: Vulptices were a non-sentient species of omnivorous and gregarious canids from the mineral world Crait. They were distinguished by their coats made up of white crystalline bristles.

label: Wampa
attackSummary: left leg(22p/2s); right leg(22p/2s); teeth(30p/2s); head(15p/2s); left claw(17p/2s); right claw(17p/2s)
description: wampa were a carnivorous, white-furred species which dwelled on the snow-clad planet Hoth.

label: war wyrm
description: The war wyrm (or sometimes called the 'sith wyrm') were a truly colossal creature believed to have been created on the fourth moon of Yavin where one such creature lived in a large subterranean lair beneath a Massassi temple. The war wyrm was originally an infant exogorth that had been mutated and warped by Sith alchemy. They were very rare and very large and several specimens were believed to hav

label: Warbird
attackSummary: serrated beak(24p/2s); left claws(6p/2s); right claws(6p/2s); head(15p/2s); tail(16p/2s)
description: The Warbird (or 'Sith warbird') was a species of huge flightless avian from the frigid planet Khar Delba. Sith warbirds were notorious for their bad temper and they typically used their large size to ram down their prey and gore them with their serrated beaks. After the end of the Great Sith War, Sith warbirds continued to be found throughout the galaxy, with survivors of the conflict breeding on

label: whisperbird
description: Whisper birds were energetic avians native to the moon Yavin 4. They were known for their radiant plumage and gained their name due to their seemingly noiseless flight. They used their dexterous tongue to emit their sweet, low-pitched song or call. These traits made them popular pets with avian enthausiasts and wild populations soon appeared from escapees on numerous worlds (even on polluted world

label: womp rat
attackSummary: left claw(8.5p/2s); right claw(8.5p/2s); Bite(8p/2s); head(4p/2s)
description: Womp rats were large, omnivorous rodents native to Tatooine that were widely considered to be pests. While womp rats were opportunists and fond of carrion, they were also predators. Although their normal prey included smaller animals, such as scurriers.

label: woolamander
attackSummary: left fist(9p/1.5s); right fist(9p/1.5s); Bite(12p/2s); head(6p/2s)
description: Woolamanders were curious social creatures that originated on the jungle moon of Yavin 4. They fed on fruit and other vegetation that would ferment in their pot-bellies. Colouful primate often made for exotic pets and these sociable animals were spread to multiple worlds where upon escaping wild populations soon established themselves.

label: worrt
attackSummary: webbed foot(4p/1.5s); webbed foot(4p/1.5s); prehensile tongue(8p/2s); head(6p/1.5s)
description: The Worrt was an amphibious creature native to the planet Tatooine, though they could also be found on other worlds (including Nal Hutta and Phaeda). Worrts were omnivorous, but was also known to attempt to eat rocks and metal objects. They used their long, prehensile tongue to catch smaller prey, such as gorgs, but were known to also attack creatures larger than itself.

label: wraid
attackSummary: left claw(16p/1.5s); right claw(16p/1.5s); teeth(16p/2s); head(16p/2s)
description: Wraids were large reptilian creatures found on many desert planets across the galaxy (including but not limited to Tatooine, Ruhnuk, Korriban and even Tython). They were carnivorous creatures, relying on scavening and ambush to find their prey. Wraids were often over hunted for their valuable hides, causing their populations to spike and fall.

label: wyyyschokk
attackSummary: fanged chelicerae(20p/2s); fanged pedipalp(15p/2s); fanged pedipalp(15p/2s); head(12p/2s)
description: Wyyyschokk were a species of gigantic spider that lived on the planet Kashyyyk. Both highly intelligent and extremely hostile, they could ensnare prey by casting webbing at them.

label: yobshrimp
description: Yobshrimp were a carnivorous crustacean native to the shallow waters of the planet Naboo. These clawed creatures were typically preyed upon by animals such as Blarths and larger scalefish. Some considered this animal a delicacy and many fishing families cultivated the yobshrimp for consumption which resulted in it's dispersal to various worlds.

label: zakkeg
attackSummary: left claws(18p/1.5s); right claws(18p/1.5s); Bite(26p/2s); head(20p/2s); tail(14p/2.2s)
description: Zakkegs were rare alpha-predators indigenous to the moon of Dxun. They were huge, armoured quadrupeds, typically solitary and territorial. Even Mandalorians were impressed by someone who killed one, and one could gain great honor for proving one's success. Due to this, several Mandalorian clans and big game hunters exported these creatures to numerous worlds to provide a ready supply of the beasts

label: zeer
attackSummary: horn(16p/2s); left hoof(12p/2s); right hoof(12p/2s); Bite(9p/2s)
description: The Zeer were a species of long-necked herbivorous animals of unknown planetary origin. They were sociable herd animals. Their exotic appearance made them popular in both galactic zoological exhibits and circuses, ultimately leading to their spread to multiple worlds in order to supply demand.

label: ysalamir

attackSummary: left claw(8p/2s); right claw(8p/2s); Bite(10p/2.6s); head(5p/2s)

label: giant ant
description: A mutated giant ant. Relentless and hungry.

label: titan
attackSummary: left fist(25.2p/3s); right fist(25.2p/3s); teeth(40.2p/2s); head(12.0p/2s)
description: A huge likeness of a human, constantly hungry and incredibly strong. Giants have a large reserve of health because their real body is hidden behind a thick outer flesh shell.

label: anaconda
description: The anaconda is the heaviest and one of the longest known snake species, reaching lengths of 5 meters. They are a primarily nocturnal species that tends to spend most of its life in or around water.

label: arctic coyote
attackSummary: left claw(7.7p/2s); right claw(7.7p/2s); Bite(14.2p/2.1s); head(6p/2s)
description: A small canine native to tundra and boreal forests. It's capable of hunting much bigger prey, and is often found in packs, similar to a wolf.

label: beagle
attackSummary: left claw(3.6p/2s); right claw(3.6p/2s); cute little teeth(4.8p/2s); head(2p/2s)
description: A small scent hound developed primarily to hunt hares. It's intelligence and loyalty make it a valuable companion on the hunt.

label: beaver
attackSummary: left claw(5p/2s); right claw(5p/2s); Bite(5.5p/2s); head(3p/2s)
description: A large semiaquatic rodent with a flat, paddle-shaped tail and webbed hind feet. Beavers are renowned for their innate construction skills, building their homes, or "lodges", out of sticks, twigs, rocks, and mud in lakes, streams, and tidal river deltas. Beavers are well known for building dams across streams and constructing their lodges in the artificial ponds which form.

label: black bear
attackSummary: left claw(17p/2s); right claw(17p/2s); Bite(23.6p/2.6s); head(11p/2s)
description: A medium sized omnivorous mammal adapted for cold climates. Bears' thick blubber and fur keeps them warm in winter.\n\nWhile their usual diet consists of fish, berries, honey, and scavenged meat, the black bear is capable of using its massive strength and deadly claws to kill live prey. They are startlingly quick for such lumbering creatures.

label: boombat
attackSummary: left claw(3p/1.5s); right claw(3p/1.5s); Bite(5.5p/2s); head(5p/2s)
description: Due to some insane experiment, these cute, fluffy rodents create a powerful fire-starting explosion when killed.

label: camel
attackSummary: left hoof(9p/2s); right hoof(9p/2s); Bite(10p/2s); head(7p/2s)
description: A large land mammal adapted to arid environments. Domesticated since ancient times, its wool and leather are both exceptionally good at insulating against the desert heat, and its milk is quite nourishing. label: abyssinian cat
attackSummary: left claw(6p/1.5s); right claw(6p/1.5s); Bite(7p/2s); head(3p/2s)
description: A slender, fine-boned, medium sized shrubland cat.

label: bengal cat
attackSummary: left claw(6p/1.5s); right claw(6p/1.5s); Bite(7p/2s); head(3p/2s)
description: A domesticated hybrid of a domestic cat and tropical leopard.

label: british shorthair cat
attackSummary: left claw(6p/1.5s); right claw(6p/1.5s); Bite(7p/2s); head(3p/2s)
description: A pedigreed version of a regular british cat, with a distinctively chunky body, dense coat and a very broad face. While being relatively powerful-looking due to the large chest and massive paws, these cats are absolutely harmless.

label: maine coon
attackSummary: left claw(10p/1.5s); right claw(10p/1.5s); Bite(8p/2s); head(6p/2s)
description: A largest domesticated cat, it has a distinctive physical appearance and valuable hunting skills. It's a large and sociable cat, hence it has been given a nickname "the gentle giant."

label: munchkin cat
attackSummary: left claw(6p/1.5s); right claw(6p/1.5s); Bite(7p/2s); head(3p/2s)
description: Also known as a sausage cat, this new cat breed has distinctively short legs. Sweet natured, playful and people-oriented, these cats are perfect companions for people with lazy lifestyle.

label: norwegian forest cat
attackSummary: left claw(6p/1.5s); right claw(6p/1.5s); Bite(7p/2s); head(3p/2s)
description: A cat adapted for very cold climates due to the top coat of glossy, water-shedding hair.

label: persian cat
attackSummary: left claw(6p/1.5s); right claw(6p/1.5s); Bite(7p/2s); head(3p/2s)
description: A long haired cat originating from desert wildcats, Persian cats are regal, intelligent and agile, which makes them excellent for hunting small rodents and birds.

label: siamese cat
attackSummary: left claw(6p/1.5s); right claw(6p/1.5s); Bite(7p/2s); head(3p/2s)
description: A cat with distinctively triangular head, blue eyes and long and muscular body, renowned for it's social nature.

label: somali cat
attackSummary: left claw(6p/1.5s); right claw(6p/1.5s); Bite(7p/2s); head(3p/2s)
description: A shrubland cat, sharing the same family as the Abyssinian cat. It has a bushy tail and almond shaped eyes.

label: sphynx cat
attackSummary: left claw(6p/1.5s); right claw(6p/1.5s); Bite(7p/2s); head(3p/2s)
description: A cat known for it's lack of fur, developed due to selective breeding. Being warm to the touch, they lose body temperature easily which makes it seek out heat sources.

label: cheetah
attackSummary: left claw(11p/1.5s); right claw(11p/1.5s); Bite(16p/2s); head(9p/2s)
description: These cats are lean and lanky, allowing them to reach incredible speeds. They have tan-colored fur with solid black, round spots, very long legs, a long narrow tail for balance, and a deep chest that contains large lungs.

label: chihuahua
attackSummary: left claw(1.6p/2s); right claw(1.6p/2s); cute little teeth(2.8p/2s); head(1.2p/2s)
description: A small dog, just a little bit bigger than a rat. Back in ancient times considered to be reincarnations of different deities and are to this day considered sacred.

label: corgi
attackSummary: left claw(3.6p/2s); right claw(3.6p/2s); cute little teeth(4.8p/2s); head(2p/2s)
description: Historically used for cattle herding, Corgis quickly became popular on imperial worlds and are recognized as a symbol of royalty.

label: coyote
attackSummary: left claw(7.7p/2s); right claw(7.7p/2s); Bite(14.2p/2.1s); head(6p/2s)
description: A praire wolf native to desert and shrubland areas. It's capable of hunting much bigger prey, and is often found in packs, similar to a wolf.

label: crocodile
description: A large semi-aquatic reptile, most often found on the river banks. It's predatory insticts combined with an extremely strong jaw allow them to tackle much larger prey. Older crocodiles can grow to monstrous sizes.

label: desert tortoise
description: This heavily armored desert-dwelling reptile is known for its slow moving speed and extremely hard, flat domed shell, making it tough to kill. Desert tortoises, despite their small size, are great combat animals and are relatively easy to tame.

label: french bulldog
attackSummary: left claw(3.6p/2s); right claw(3.6p/2s); cute little teeth(4.8p/2s); head(2p/2s)
description: Originally used for bull-baiting, which is an act of pitting one species of animal against bulls, these bulldogs are fierce opponents and due to their small body-size, they are fast, agile and lethal.

label: german shepherd
attackSummary: left claw(9p/1.5s); right claw(9p/1.5s); bite(16p/2s); head(5p/2s)
description: A large sized working dog. Easy to train and good at following instructions, they are often seen accompanying glitterworld police forces and rimworld farmers.

label: gila monster
attackSummary: left claw(8p/2s); right claw(8p/2s); teeth(8p/2s); head(5p/2s)
description: A large, slow moving type of lizard found mostly in the desert, known for its highly venomous bite which inflicts a severe toxic build-up in its prey. Outlanders to this day believe in tales which state that this lizard is a spawn from hell, and that its foul breath is lethal.

label: giraffe
attackSummary: left hoof(14p/2.2s); right hoof(14p/2.2s); Bite(8p/2s); head(6p/2.6s)
description: A giraffe is one of the tallest mammals in the galaxy, using it's long neck to reach leaves and branches unavailable for smaller herbivores.

label: great dane
attackSummary: left claw(8.5p/2s); right claw(8.5p/2s); Bite(14.2p/2.6s); head(5p/2s)
description: One of the largest species of dogs, Great Danes are dignified, elegant and strong.

label: hedgehog
attackSummary: left claw(2p/2s); right claw(2p/2s); Bite(3p/2s); head(3p/2s)
description: Hedgehogs are diminutive mammals with cone-shaped faces, short legs and bodies that are covered with porcupine-like quills. When in danger, the hedgehog rolls into a ball so that the quills cover the entire area of their exposed body and protects the animal from predators.

label: hyena
attackSummary: left claw(7.7p/2s); right claw(7.7p/2s); Bite(16.2p/2.1s); head(6p/2s)
description: A large dog-like carnivore most often found in the shrublands and deserts. A common trope in tribal legends, the laughter produced by these animals can sow fear during the long desert nights.

label: indian elephant
description: The Indian elephant is one of the largest unmodified land animals. In general, Indian elephants are smaller, have smaller ears, but relatively broader skulls and larger trunks than African elephants, and have the highest body point on the head.

label: jaguar
attackSummary: left claw(11p/1.5s); right claw(11p/1.5s); Bite(16p/2s); head(9p/2s)
description: A large felid species and the only existing member of the Panthera native to the Americas in old Earth. This spotted cat closely resembles the leopard, but is usually larger and sturdier. The jaguar enjoys swimming and is largely a solitary, opportunistic, stalk-and-ambush predator at the top of the food chain.

label: kangaroo
description: Kangaroo is a large, human-sized marsupial with strong legs and powerful arms. It's favoured by tribal hunters due to its tender meat and heat resistant leather. Kangaroos make for powerful adversaries in melee combat, and can be trained easily to become animal super-soldiers.

label: koala
attackSummary: left claw(2p/2s); right claw(2p/2s); Bite(5p/2s); head(3p/2s)
description: Koalas are easily recognizable for their stout body and large, round heads with fluffy ears. They typically inhabit arid and temperate woodlands, but can rarely be seen in tropical areas. Favoured by royal families, koalas are great household animals due to their wonderful nuzzling effect.

label: lemur
attackSummary: left fist(3.6p/1.5s); right fist(3.6p/1.5s); Bite(4p/2s); head(2p/2s)
description: A small primate, lemurs are arboreal, and usually nocturnal. They have a pointed snout, large eyes, and a long tail. Although they are social creatures, they have traditionally been regarded as being less intelligent than other primates, since they don't exhibit behaviours of tool use in the wild.

label: lion
attackSummary: left claw(15p/1.5s); right claw(15p/1.5s); Bite(18p/2s); head(9p/2s)
description: A king of the animal kingdom, a lion is a muscular, deep-chested cat with a short head and a prominent mane. Being the biggest of the cat species, lions are excellent combat animals despite their Wildness.

label: mandrill
attackSummary: left fist(5.5p/1.5s); right fist(5.5p/1.5s); Bite(14p/2s); head(5p/2s)
description: Mandrills are one of the largest of all monkeys. They are shy and reclusive primates that live only in rain forests. Mandrills are extremely colorful, perhaps more so than any other mammal. They are easily identifiable by the blue and red skin on their faces and their brightly hued rumps.

label: megawolverine
attackSummary: left claw(21p/1.4s); right claw(21p/1.4s); Bite(22p/2.1s); head(15p/2s)
description: A giant, genetically-engineered predator with massive paws to rip apart prey. Thick fur allows it to survive the coldest of climates, whilst it strength allows it to hunt even the largest of mammals for food.

label: megascorpion
description: A giant, genetically-engineered scorpion. Once created as a perfect assassination tool, it is not often seen returning to it's natural habitat - desert. A very potent poison in it's stinger helps it in tacking even much bigger prey. A eusocial creature, it cannot reproduce individually.

label: platypus
attackSummary: left claw(2p/2s); right claw(2p/2s); ToxicBite;Poke(9p/2s); ToxicBite;Poke(9p/2s); head(1p/2s)
description: Platypus is the sole surviving representative of its animal family. They are beaver-tailed, duck billed mammals, known for the fact that they lay eggs. It is an omnivore animal, capable of killing small rodents with it's venomous ankle spurs.

label: poodle
attackSummary: left claw(8.5p/2s); right claw(8.5p/2s); Bite(14.2p/2.6s); head(5p/2s)
description: Large, pampered dogs, historically used for bird hunting, now mostly residing in imperial palaces and royal gardens.

label: pug
attackSummary: left claw(3.6p/2s); right claw(3.6p/2s); cute little teeth(4.8p/2s); head(2p/2s)
description: A small dog with physically distinctive features of a wrinkly, short-muzzled face, and curled tail. They are known for being extremely social and friendly, however due to years of genetic alterations they have a very short lifespan. Whatever life they have, they will always cheer up people around them.

label: rattlesnake
description: A highly venomous snake, receiving its name from a rattle at the end of their tail. The sound generated sounds as a warning to any predators, however in case it doesn't work, rattlesnake's venom-fangs inflict extremely painful toxin.

label: red panda
attackSummary: left fist(3.6p/1.5s); right fist(3.6p/1.5s); Bite(4p/2s); head(2p/2s)
description: The red panda is a small mammal, slightly larger than a domestic cat, with a bear-like body and thick russet fur. The belly and limbs are black, and there are white markings on the side of the head and above its small eyes. Red pandas are very skillful and acrobatic animals that predominantly stay in trees. It is a solitary animal, mainly active from dusk to dawn, though they can be quite affectio

label: rottweiler
attackSummary: left claw(8.5p/2s); right claw(8.5p/2s); Bite(16.2p/2.6s); head(5p/2s)
description: A large domestic dog and one of the oldest herding breeds. Being one of the most hard working dogs, it is a perfect companions for farmers and cattle herders.

label: shih-tzu
attackSummary: left claw(3.6p/2s); right claw(3.6p/2s); cute little teeth(4.8p/2s); head(2p/2s)
description: An oriental toy dog, Shih-Tzu have extremely long and soft hair. While they are kind of useless, petting them provides people with great comfort.

label: tapir
description: A large, herbivorous mammal, similar in shape to a pig, with a short nose trunk, tapirs inhabit jungle and forest regions.

label: welsh terrier
attackSummary: left claw(9.7p/2s); right claw(9.7p/2s); Bite(14.2p/2.6s); head(6p/2s)
description: A hunting dog, welsh terriers are perfect for small rodents, foxes and badgers. Due to their intelligence they are perfect at way-finding, always able to return home after running into the woods.

label: wild goose
description: A non-domesticated grey goose. Compared to their domesticated brethren, which have been selected over thousands of years for larger size, wild geese don't lay as many eggs, and they are renowned for their aggressive temperament. Peace was never an option.

label: wildebeest
attackSummary: Bite(8.8p/2.6s); head(12p/2s); left hoof(8p/2s); right hoof(8p/2s)
description: Also called Gnu, this wild cow earned it's name with it's menacing horns, pointed beard and large head. These animals are known from their migrations and the size of their herds.\n\nDue to its Wildness, it produces milk at much slower rate than a standard cow.

label: zebra
attackSummary: head(12p/2.9s); left hoof(8p/2s); right hoof(8p/2s); Bite(6p/2s)
description: A member of the horse family native to arid and desert areas. Whilst it doesn't share the same bodysize as a horse, due to years of evolution it's one of the fastest hooved animals.

label: hydra
